tools.name: get_miaoduo_node_screenshot
tools.description:
Get a screenshot from a miaoduo design node. Returns the image as base64 encoded data.
miaoduo is a vector design tool, where each node represents a part or whole of a UI design.
User might provide a URL like https://api.miaoduo.com/file/{docId}?nodeId={nodeId}&type=design.

This tool helps users:
1. Get a visual representation of a design node
2. Share design mockups with stakeholders
3. Compare designs across different iterations

The result will be a base64 encoded image that can be used directly in applications.
